description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for comments in the application. It includes a command for deleting a comment, a validator for the command, and a handler that processes the deletion by querying the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Container class for the Delete comment feature, including command, validator, and handler.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents the data required to delete a comment, namely the article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command to ensure the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the processing of the delete command by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for the Command object.

methods.name: Handle(Command message, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the delete command, removing the specified comment from the context.
